content.text: {"root_causes":[{"service":"reservation","fault_kind":"pod_unavailable","evidence":[{"kind":"metric","sql":"SELECT attr_k8s_pod_name, metric, value, time FROM abnormal_metrics WHERE attr_k8s_pod_name LIKE 'reservation-%' AND metric IN ('k8s.container.ready','k8s.container.restarts') ORDER BY time","claim":"Reservation pod reports container ready=0 for the whole abnormal window while its restart count climbs from 3 to 6."},{"kind":"trace","sql":"SELECT service_name, span_name, attr_span_kind, count(*) n, sum((attr_status_code='Error')::int) err FROM abnormal_traces WHERE span_name ILIKE '%reserv%' GROUP BY ALL","claim":"Reservation server spans disappear in abnormal (normal: 524 CheckAvailability server spans); frontend's calls to reservation all error."}]}],"propagation":[{"from":"reservation","to":"frontend","evidence":[{"kind":"trace","sql":"SELECT service_name, span_name, attr_span_kind, attr_http_response_status_code sc, count(*) n, sum((attr_status_code='Error')::int) err FROM abnormal_traces WHERE service_name='frontend' AND span_name IN ('reservation.Reservation/CheckAvailability','HTTP /hotels') GROUP BY ALL","claim":"All 718 frontend CheckAvailability client calls error, and every HTTP /hotels server span returns 500."}]}]}
